```{r}
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gh)
library(cranlogs)
library(reactable)
library(echarts4r)

source("stats.R")

fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")

# One "icon + value + label" stat, shown in the overview card's stats grid.
overview_stat <- function(icon, value, label) {
  paste0(
    "<div class=\"overview-stat\">",
    as.character(bsicons::bs_icon(icon)),
    "<span class=\"overview-stat-value\">",
    fmt(value),
    "</span>",
    "<span class=\"overview-stat-label\">",
    label,
    "</span></div>"
  )
}

# Body of one overview card: CRAN check status, the R-CMD-check badge, the
# Codecov badge (all built in stats.R) and a small grid of repository stats.
# The card itself and its header (the package name) are provided by the
# dashboard cell + its `title` option.
overview_card <- function(pkg) {
  last_release_info <- get_last_release_info(pkg)
  htmltools::HTML(paste0(
    "<div class=\"overview-cran\"><strong>CRAN checks:</strong> ",
    get_cran_checks(pkg),
    "</div>",
    "<span class=\"last-cran-update\"><strong>Last CRAN release:</strong><br>",
    last_release_info[["date_last_release"]],
    " (",
    last_release_info[["n_weeks_last_release"]],
    " weeks ago) ",
    "</span>",
    "<div class=\"overview-badges\">",
    "<span>",
    get_ci_status(pkg),
    "</span>",
    "<span>",
    get_coverage(pkg),
    "</span>",
    "<span>",
    get_pkgdown_status(pkg),
    "</span>",
    "</div>",
    "<div class=\"overview-stats\">",
    "<div class=\"overview-stats-row\">",
    overview_stat(
      "people",
      get_number_of_unique_contributors(pkg),
      "contributors"
    ),
    overview_stat("diagram-2", get_number_of_forks(pkg), "forks"),
    "</div>",
    "<div class=\"overview-stats-row\">",
    overview_stat(
      "exclamation-circle",
      get_number_of_open_issues(pkg),
      "open issues"
    ),
    overview_stat(
      "git",
      get_number_of_prs(pkg, state = "open"),
      "open PRs"
    ),
    "</div>",
    "</div>"
  ))
}
```


# Overview


### Row {.overview-row}

```{r}
#| title: palaeoverse
overview_card("palaeoverse")
```

```{r}
#| title: rmacrostrat
overview_card("rmacrostrat")
```

```{r}
#| title: rphylopic
overview_card("rphylopic")
```

```{r}

overview_card("sepkoski")
```
